title: Rude emails
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What makes an email sound rude even when it contains no insulting words?
How can people disagree strongly by email without creating unnecessary conflict?
Have you ever misunderstood someone's tone in a message? What caused the misunderstanding?
Is it better to write a very direct email or a softer, more polite one at work?
If an email makes you angry, how long should you wait before replying?
